frontend.deduplication: requestWithFrontendCache deduplicates identical in-flight GET requests by normalized method/path/body key.
frontend.batching: /capability/bootstrap batches module, adapter, execution-provider, and live-gate bootstrap reads through the Next proxy.
abort_support_added: Next backend proxy fetch and capability bootstrap fan-out fetch

jobs_fetch.default_scope: All frontend GET /jobs and /jobs/* requests default to 15000ms unless a caller overrides timeoutMs.
jobs_fetch.fallback: Keep cached list payload when present; otherwise render empty list payload and keep UI interactive.
